description: Navigate to the 'Double Entry Table' activity in GCompris (found in the Puzzle category, icon showing a matrix/grid). Complete at least 2 levels of the activity. The activity requires you to drag items (like flowers, shapes, or objects) into a grid where the row and column headers define the properties (e.g., Red + Flower = Red Flower). After completing Level 2, take a screenshot of the completed grid or the success animation and save it to '~/double_entry_success.png'.
